title: Audio latency and dropouts over a long session
hypothesis: GpuVM's USB speaker adds no more delay than Steam Streaming Speakers on the way to Moonlight and keeps the sound clean over a 10-minute session: no underruns in the speaker and no dropouts of 15 ms or more in Moonlight.

conclusion: Adopted. Over 10 minutes the speaker carried the VM's sound to Moonlight with no dropout of 15 ms or more, 63.4 ms after the VM played it, 3.6 ms more than Steam Streaming Speakers (59.8 ms), in line with the ~9 ms of audio it keeps queued. It had 7 underruns of about 2 ms each (15 ms in 10 minutes), too short to show as dropouts; keeping a few more milliseconds queued would remove them at the cost of that much latency. Moonlight failed once to connect (RTSP handshake, error -1) right after Sunshine had been restarted twice in a row; it did not happen in the 10-minute run.
